title: Recommended flags on Ollama models, per job (enhance, describe, agent)
description: The LLM settings picker flags recommended models per job for remote providers (RECOMMENDED_REMOTE_MODELS in services/llmEngines.mjs) but deliberately gives Ollama none, so a local user cannot tell which installed model to pick for which task. Flag enhance with the enhancer of record (gemma-4-abliterated-12b) and describe with a local vision model once a scored run backs it. Agent needs research first: the only local model Fabio has driven the agent with, dolphin3-abliterated, is too weak for the job; find an Ollama model smart enough for the agent that does not take all the VRAM, or leave agent unflagged. A flag nobody earned is worse than none.
